context: Request: which of the firm's M&A deals never made it to closing, including mergers that could not get regulatory clearance. Rubric: eight matters (1001-00005, 1002-00004, 1003-00001, 1011-00005, 1017-00007, 1018-00008, 1020-00006, 1032-00005) plus a precision criterion; the in-progress 1045-00005 (Tessera) draft deal is outside the permitted set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches reading agreements, memos, emails and closing documents of four matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: One glob for file names containing a deal-type word.
Lists all files of ten candidate matters from that glob.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches reading memos, notices, letters and closing checklists of six candidates.
Writes two matters as deals that did not close and three more as having no documented closing.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One file-name glob reached two of eight qualifying matters; the answer also listed three matters without a documented closing.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only search was one file-name glob for a deal-type word; six qualifying matters whose files did not match never surfaced, and it never searched document text.

other_errors.why: It listed three more matters, including one still being negotiated, as deals with no documented closing.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find to depth two (empty).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads a draft agreement, memos, an issues list and emails of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: One files-with-matches grep with a brace-extension glob; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, closing documents and termination letters of three more listing matters.
Writes one listing matter, a deal still being negotiated, as the only one without a closing.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its single grep returned nothing; it answered from the listing matters and named a deal still being negotiated.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its one grep used a brace-extension glob and returned nothing; it neither retried with another pattern nor searched file names, and fell back to the matters at the top of the listing.

other_errors.why: It counted a deal still being negotiated as one that never closed.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches reading agreements, memos, emails and closing documents of the four matters at the top of the listing; no keyword search at all.
Writes one listing matter, a deal still being negotiated, as the only one that did not close.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; answered from the matters at the top of the listing and named a deal still being negotiated.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the four matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so none of the qualifying matters surfaced.

other_errors.why: It counted a deal still being negotiated as one that never closed.

divergence: All three failed and none ran an effective search. T2 never searched (partial listing as corpus); T1's single grep returned nothing (search miss); T0's single file-name glob reached two of eight qualifying matters (search miss). All three read the matters at the top of the listing first, and all three counted a deal from that listing that was still being negotiated as one that never closed (over-inclusion).
